title: How to use Mess Manager
intro: Short guides for every part of the app. Tap a topic to open it.

topics.title: Getting started
steps: A Room is one shared kitchen, flat or group. Everyone in it sees the same expenses.
To start a new Room: Home → "+ Create a new Room". Pick the country — the currency and time zone are set for you. You become its Admin.
To join a Room: ask its Admin for the Room code, then Home → "+ Join a Room" and type the code. The Admin must approve you before you can see anything.
The menu at the bottom: Home (your Rooms and quick buttons), Inbox (all notifications) and Me (profile and settings).

topics.title: Adding an expense
steps: Home → "Add expense", or inside the Room → "+ Add expense".
Write what you bought and the amount. You are always the person who paid.
The expense is shared equally by everyone in the Room; the app shows what each person pays.
Pick Today, Yesterday or type another date. A receipt photo is optional.
You can edit or delete your own expense for 30 minutes. After that only an Admin can, and never after the cycle is settled. Every change stays in the history.

topics.title: Need Requests
steps: Use it when something runs out: Home → "Need request" or Room → "Need something". Tap a suggestion (Gas, Rice, Milk…) or type your own.
Everyone in the Room gets a phone notification with a special longer sound. You can turn that sound off in Me → Notification settings.
Whoever will buy it taps "I'll buy it", so nobody buys it twice.
After buying, tap "Bought — add expense": the expense form opens already filled in.

topics.title: Balances: who pays, who gets back
steps: Room → Balances shows, for this cycle, what each person paid and their share.
"You pay" (orange) means you owe money; "You receive" (blue) means others owe you.
Every person pays only for the days they were in the Room.

topics.title: Settlement and paying
steps: At the end of a cycle the Admin creates the settlement. It stays pinned on your phone and on Home until you open it and tap "I have seen this settlement".
At the top you see your part: how much you pay or get, and what is still left.
"Who pays whom" shows the fewest payments that settle everyone.
After paying, tap "Mark as paid": enter the amount and method. For bank or wallet transfers add a screenshot or the transaction number.
The Admin confirms your payment. Until it is fully paid you get a reminder every morning.

topics.title: Something looks wrong? Raise a dispute
steps: Open the expense, payment or settlement line and tap "Report a problem".
Choose the reason and add a short note. Everyone sees an "Under dispute" mark.
An Admin checks it and accepts or rejects it with a reason. Mistakes in a settled cycle are fixed with an adjustment in the open cycle.

topics.title: Reports and your records
steps: Home → "Reports" (or Room → Reports): download a PDF or CSV of a cycle or of all records.
Each report has a reference number that anyone can check in Reports → Check a report.
Records are kept for 2 complete months after a cycle is settled, then deleted. A week before, everyone gets the PDF by email — keep it as your copy.

topics.title: Using the app without internet
steps: You can still open your Rooms and see the last saved expenses and balances.
Expenses, Need Requests and payment claims you add offline wait on the phone with a "Waiting to sync" mark and are sent automatically when the internet is back.
Balances shown offline are marked "Estimated". Approving members, confirming payments and settling need internet.

topics.title: Your profile, privacy and account
steps: Me → My profile: change your name and photo. Only people in your Rooms see them; only Admins see your email.
Me: language, theme, App Lock (PIN or fingerprint), notification settings and ad choices.
Me → Privacy Policy & Terms: read them again at any time.
Me → Your data: download everything about you, or delete your account. Leaving a Room is in Room → Room settings.

topics.title: Members: approve, roles, remove
steps: Room → Members: approve or reject join requests. Nobody gets in without approval.
Make another member an Admin so the Room never depends on one person. The last Admin cannot leave.
Removing a member needs your password. Their past expenses stay, marked "(removed)", and Admins still see their email to invite them again.
Invite people with Room → Room settings → "Send invite" (WhatsApp, SMS…).

topics.title: Creating a settlement
steps: In the Room, on the cycle card tap "Generate settlement".
Choose the last day it covers: the cycle end, yesterday, or any day you type. Expenses after that day move to the next cycle.
The settled cycle is locked: nobody can add, edit or delete its expenses. A later correction is made with an adjustment.
You see who has seen the settlement (Delivered / Seen / Acknowledged).

topics.title: Confirming payments
steps: When a member marks a payment as paid, all Admins are notified. Check the proof and tap Confirm, or Reject with a reason.
Cash received in hand: open the settlement and use "Record payment received".
An Admin cannot confirm their own payment if another Admin exists. Admins get a daily reminder while payments wait.

topics.title: Room settings
steps: Room → Room settings → Settings: name, country, time zone and cycle (daily, weekly, monthly).
Time zone and cycle changes start from the next cycle; currency can change only at the start of a new cycle. Every member is told about each change.

contact: Still stuck? Write to us from Me → Contact support.
